{{Quote|I am programmed for a wide array of tasks, including but not limited to meal preparation, ship maintenance, janitorial duty and etiquette.|2V-R8, to the [[Hunter (individual)|Hunter]]|<ref name="TOR:JR" />}}
'''2V-R8''', also known as '''Twovee Areight''', was a [[Seneschal-series factotum droid]] owned by the [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] who became the [[Grand Champion of the Great Hunt]]. Assigned to [[Hunter's D5-Mantis Patrol Craft]] when it was stolen by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]<ref name="TOR:JR" /> in [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_dates" /> 2V-R8 was responsible for maintaining the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] and ensuring that its crew remained comfortable.<ref name="TOR:JR" />

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' all four Imperial classes receive a 2V-R8 droid as their companion when they acquire their ship. Hunter's 2V-R8 is the steward of the [[D5-Mantis Patrol Craft]] and is identical to other droids of its class except for a few lines during its introduction. Beyond the initial conversation with the player, 2V-R8 has no story interactions and is only used for gameplay activities.<ref name="TOR:JR" />
